text: Assumption: Upon calling the destructor, occupied file descriptors are closed and internal buffers are cleaned up — is this correct?

assumption: Upon calling the destructor, occupied file descriptors are closed and internal buffers are cleaned up.
rationale: The class combines read and write operations on files, which typically requires orderly resource cleanup.
